# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old in Volume 1; around fifty-seven to sixty in Volume 2.  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c25 P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Unmarried; living at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper and farmer at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with angular features, dark hair showing grey streaks, and hair twisted up in a hard little knot secured by two wire hairpins. She maintains an exceptionally clean, neat household and yard. In her later years, her hair becomes snow-white, though her eyes age well after an eye scare.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v2 c26 P2](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0002)_

## Personality

Marilla is a woman of narrow experience, rigid conscience, and strict notions of discipline, who tries to raise children with a firm hand. Beneath her stern, unexpressive exterior lies a deeply loving heart, a saving sense of humor, and a capacity to mellow over time. Though pragmatic and unsentimental, she is deeply loyal to her family and neighbors.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c7 P19](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0019), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v2 c25 P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046)_

- To maintain and keep Green Gables in the family  <sub>[v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014), [v1 c38 P27](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0027)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived a quiet, secluded life at Green Gables with her brother Matthew. Deciding to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm, they were mistakenly sent an eleven-year-old girl, Anne Shirley. Although Marilla initially intended to send Anne back, she agreed to keep her and took charge of her upbringing. Over the years, Marilla's strict discipline gradually softened into deep maternal love for Anne. Following the sudden death of her brother Matthew and facing failing eyesight that threatened her independence, Marilla considered selling Green Gables, but Anne gave up her college scholarship to stay and help her. Later, when Marilla took in the orphaned twins Davy and Dora Keith, and when Mrs. Rachel Lynde came to live at Green Gables, Anne was able to attend Redmond College, leaving Marilla well-cared for at home.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 c38 P18](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0018), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P22](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0022)_
